descriptionByLocale.it:

L'incumbent applica un forte background tecnico in biomolecole caratterizzazione a entusiasmanti progetti interdisciplinari che lavorano in un ambiente di team collaborativo sulle strumentazioni all'avanguardia. Collabora con altri scienziati e partner esterni per sviluppare saggi analitici idonei all'uso, suggerire flussi di lavoro e fornire supporto tecnico e formazione per consentire processi critici decisionali e sostenere continue attività di sviluppo della droga. In questa posizione, un elevato livello di conoscenza delle tecniche biofisiche è essenziale per fornire analisi analitiche appropriate di fase e per supportare una maggiore caratterizzazione del prodotto. Lo scienziato senior contribuirà a tradurre piattaforme innovative e nuove tecnologie in metodi completamente sviluppati e possibilmente automatizzati. L'entusiasmo scientifico, la creatività, l'esperienza di laboratorio e l'impegno saranno essenziali per il successo del team e degli obiettivi e dei tempi organizzativi. Principali responsabilità e responsabilità
• Responsabile per la progettazione e l'esecuzione di esperimenti e per l'interpretazione dei risultati delle tecniche basate sulla biofisica e sulla cromatografia per supportare la caratterizzazione di nuovi prodotti derivati dal plasma e prodotti commercializzati.
• Sviluppo e implementazione di nuovi metodi analitici in base alla qualità analitica mediante principi di progettazione e qualifica appropriata in fase secondo le esigenze del progetto e del prodotto.
• Atto come Soggetto Matter Expert (SME) per argomenti relativi alla biofisica e alla cromatografia per fornire un contributo scientifico a più progetti e per l'implementazione di nuove tecnologie.
• Sostenere il trasferimento di metodi qualificati da R&D a ambiente regolamentato presso il sito appropriato (QC, CROs).

• Presente a seminari e conferenze interni ed esterni.
• Responsabile per il funzionamento degli strumenti, la risoluzione dei problemi e la manutenzione.

• Fornisci un feedback appropriato agli altri membri del team.

• Laurea post-laurea (preferibilmente PhD) in scienze biologiche, biofisica o chimica analitica. Esperienza

• La conoscenza della caratterizzazione delle particelle sub-visibili utilizzando tecnologie come la microscopia di flusso, DLS, l'analisi di tracciamento di Nano è preferita.

Position Purpose Senior Scientist with high level of experience in protein biophysics to characterize a variety of therapeutic proteins. The incumbent applies a strong technical background in biomolecules characterization to exciting interdisciplinary projects working in a collaborative team environment on state-of-the-art instrumentations. He/she will partner with other scientists and external partners to develop fit-for-purpose analytical assays, suggest workflows and provide technical support and training to enable critical process decision-making and support continuous drug development activities. In this position, a high level of knowledge of biophysical techniques is essential to deliver phase appropriate analytical assays and to support enhanced product characterization. The Senior Scientist will contribute to translate innovative platforms and new technologies into fully developed, possibly automated methods. Scientific enthusiasm, creativity, hands-on lab experience and commitment will be essential for the successful achievement of team and organizational goals and timelines. • Responsible for designing and performing experiments as well as for interpreting results from biophysical and chromatography-based techniques to support characterization of new plasma-derived product and commercialized product.
• Development and implementation of novel analytical methods according to analytic quality by design principles and phase-appropriate qualification according to project and product demands.
• Act as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for biophysical and chromatography related topics to provide scientific input to multiple projects and for the implementation of new technologies.
• Support the transfer of qualified methods from R&D to regulated environment at the appropriate site (QC, CROs).
• Author lab procedures, protocols, reports and SOPs for internal and/or external partners.
• Present at internal and external seminars and conferences.
• Responsible for instruments operation, troubleshooting and maintenance.
• Make effective use of resources (time, people, equipment and materials).

• In-depth theoretical and extensive hands-on experience on diverse biophysical techniques (e.g. SEC-MALS, DSC, Fluorescence, FTIR) for analysis of protein structure and conformation.
• Knowledge of sub-visible particles characterization using technologies such as Flow Microscopy, DLS, Nano Tracking Analysis is preferred.

Der Incumbent setzt einen starken technischen Hintergrund in der Biomolekülcharakterisierung auf spannende interdisziplinäre Projekte ein, die in einem kollaborativen Teamumfeld auf hochmodernen Instrumentierungen arbeiten. Er/sie wird mit anderen Wissenschaftlern und externen Partnern zusammenarbeiten, um geeignete analytische Assays zu entwickeln, Workflows vorzuschlagen und technische Unterstützung und Schulungen zu bieten, um kritische Prozessentscheidungen zu ermöglichen und kontinuierliche Drogenentwicklungsaktivitäten zu unterstützen. In dieser Position ist ein hohes Maß an Kenntnissen über biophysikalische Techniken unerlässlich, um phasengerechte analytische Untersuchungen zu liefern und eine verbesserte Produktcharakterisierung zu unterstützen. Der Senior Scientist wird dazu beitragen, innovative Plattformen und neue Technologien in voll entwickelte, möglicherweise automatisierte Methoden umzusetzen. Wissenschaftliche Begeisterung, Kreativität, praktische Laborerfahrung und Engagement werden für die erfolgreiche Errungenschaft von Team- und Organisationszielen und Zeitlinien unerlässlich sein. Hauptverantwortlichkeiten und Rechenschaften

• Gesetz als Fachexperte (KMU) für biophysikalische und chromatographische Themen, um wissenschaftliche Beiträge zu mehreren Projekten und zur Umsetzung neuer Technologien bereitzustellen.
• Unterstützung der Übertragung von qualifizierten Methoden von FuE auf regulierte Umwelt am geeigneten Standort (QC, CROs).
• Autore Laborverfahren, Protokolle, Berichte und SOPs für interne und/oder externe Partner.
• Auf internen und externen Seminaren und Konferenzen.
• Für Gerätebetrieb, Fehlersuche und Wartung verantwortlich.
• Wirksame Nutzung von Ressourcen (Zeit, Menschen, Ausrüstung und Materialien).
• Geben Sie ein entsprechendes Feedback an andere Teammitglieder.
• Zusammenarbeit mit Gruppenmitgliedern und funktionellen Teams, um analytische Studien, Prozessentwicklung und andere Studien zu unterstützen.
• Stellen Sie eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit anderen lokalen und globalen CSL-Funktionen im richtigen Netzwerk sicher. Bildung
• Hochschulabschluss (vorzugsweise PhD) in biologischen Wissenschaften, Biophysik oder analytischer Chemie. Erfahrung

Il programma Horizon 2 includeva una tecnologia brevettata, che migliora la resa di produzione che consente una produzione di immunoglobulina significativamente superiore dalla stessa quantità di base del plasma. Operando all'interno dell'organizzazione del programma Horizon 2, il ruolo serve come integratore primario di impresa in Tech Ops, Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering & Maintenance (E&M), e consentendo progetti di capitale, garantendo l'intento tecnico, la maturità di processo, i risultati di validazione, gli apprendisti di programma e i contenuti tecnici conformi alle normative sono tradotti coerentemente in esecuzione efficace e sostenibile in scala. Responsabilità del ruolo Horizon 2 Programma Capacità tecniche L'Enterprise Implementation Lead è responsabile per la consegna tecnica end-to-end del programma Horizon 2 attraverso lo sviluppo, l'implementazione del processo, il trasferimento tecnologico, la validazione e la creazione di sviluppo e contenuti tecnici necessari per supportare i processi normativi globali. Ciò include la traduzione di output di sviluppo in soluzioni di produzione scalabili e conformi e garantire che le conoscenze di processo, le strategie di controllo, le prove di validazione e le narrazioni tecniche conformi alle normative siano saldamente stabilite per consentire presentazioni di successo e la distribuzione in corso, nonché la nuova espansione attraverso la rete CSL.
• Guidare e integrare le attività di sviluppo tecnico attraverso l'implementazione del processo, garantendo continuità dell'intento tecnico e della prontezza per la produzione
• Definire ed eseguire strategie di implementazione di processi aziendali che convertono gli apprendimento di sviluppo in soluzioni pronte al sito, eseguibili in strutture nuove e esistenti
• Possedere e coordinare le responsabilità Tech Ops per il trasferimento di tecnologia, compresa la definizione di strategie di trasferimento, parametri di processo critici e criteri di successo in tutti i siti
• Tenere la responsabilità della strategia di validazione e dell'esecuzione associata al programma Horizon 2, assicurando che la validazione sia basata sul rischio, pronta all'ispezione e allineata alle aspettative normative
• Possedere allo sviluppo e all'integrazione dei contenuti tecnici e di sviluppo necessari per le presentazioni normative, assicurando la coerenza tra i dati di sviluppo, le prove di validazione e le narrazioni di archiviazione
• Assicurare l'allineamento tra i dati di sviluppo, i risultati delle qualifiche, le prove di validazione e i contenuti normativi per supportare la prontezza operativa e la produzione GMP sostenibile
• Drive Right-First-Time (RFT) consegna attraverso la gestione del rischio tecnico disciplinato, risoluzione dei problemi e processo decisionale basato sui dati Collaborazione, integrazione e governance
• Partner con Manufacturing on Operational Readiness fornendo ingressi Tech Ops tra cui conoscenze di processo, requisiti di trasferimento tecnico, stato di validazione e trasparenza del rischio di processo
• Partner con Engineering & Maintenance (E&M) nella fornitura di progetti per garantire che i requisiti di processo, i parametri e i criteri di accettazione di Tech Ops siano chiaramente definiti e allineati con le aspettative di progettazione, costruzione, qualificazione e erogazione di asset
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con gli Affari di Qualità e Regolazione per sviluppare, rivedere e approvare strategie di validazione, contenuti di presentazione normativi e narrazioni di prontezza di ispezione, garantendo l'allineamento tra esecuzione tecnica e impegni normativi
• Mantenere il registro di rischio tecnico, convalida e regolamentare a livello aziendale per il programma Horizon 2, con percorsi di chiara proprietà e di escalation
• Servire come principale canale di comunicazione tecnica tra siti, leadership di programma, forum di qualità, regolamentazione e governance Leadership del team

descriptionByLocale.en:
Position Purpose The Enterprise Implementation Lead – Horizon 2 is a senior Technical Operations leadership role accountable for the enterprise-wide technical implementation and validation of the Horizon 2 program. The Horizon 2 program included a patented, yield enhancing manufacturing technology that enables significantly higher immunoglobulin production from the same base amount of plasma. Operating within the Horizon 2 program organization, the role serves as the primary enterprise integrator across Tech Ops, Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering & Maintenance (E&M), and enabling capital projects, ensuring technical intent, process maturity, validation outcomes, program learnings, and regulatory-facing technical content are coherently translated into effective and sustainable execution at scale. Role Responsibilities Horizon 2 Program Technical Accountabilities The Enterprise Implementation Lead is accountable for the end-to-end technical delivery of the Horizon 2 program across development, process implementation, technology transfer, validation, and the creation of development and technical content required to support global regulatory filings. This includes translating development outputs into scalable, compliant manufacturing solutions and ensuring that process knowledge, control strategies, validation evidence, and regulatory-facing technical narratives are robustly established to enable successful submissions and ongoing deployment as well as new expansion across the CSL network.
• Lead and integrate technical development activities through to process implementation, ensuring continuity of technical intent and readiness for manufacturing scale-up
• Define and execute enterprise process implementation strategies that convert development learnings into site-ready, executable solutions across new and existing facilities
• Own and coordinate Tech Ops accountabilities for technology transfer, including definition of transfer strategies, critical process parameters, and success criteria across sites
• Hold accountability for validation strategy and execution associated with the Horizon 2 program, ensuring validation is risk-based, inspection-ready, and aligned with regulatory expectations
• Own the development and integration of technical and development content required for regulatory submissions, ensuring consistency between development data, validation evidence, and filing narratives
• Ensure alignment between development data, qualification outcomes, validation evidence, and regulatory content to support Manufacturing operational readiness and sustainable GMP production
• Drive Right-First-Time (RFT) delivery through disciplined technical risk management, issue resolution, and data-driven decision-making Cross-Functional Collaboration, Integration & Governance
• Partner with Manufacturing on Operational Readiness by providing Tech Ops inputs including process knowledge, tech transfer requirements, validation status, and process risk transparency
• Partner with Engineering & Maintenance (E&M) in project delivery to ensure Tech Ops process requirements, parameters, and acceptance criteria are clearly defined and aligned with design, construction, qualification, and asset handover expectations
• Partner closely with Quality and Regulatory Affairs to jointly develop, review, and approve validation strategies, regulatory submission content, and inspection readiness narratives, ensuring alignment between technical execution and regulatory commitments
• Maintain the enterprise-level technical, validation, and regulatory risk register for the Horizon 2 program, with clear ownership and escalation paths
• Serve as the primary technical communication conduit between sites, program leadership, Quality, Regulatory, and governance forums Team Leadership
• Lead a lean, senior Tech Ops-focused implementation and validation team (direct and matrixed)
• Drive enterprise learning, reuse, and continuous improvement acros

Im Rahmen der Horizon 2 Programmorganisation fungiert die Rolle als primärer Unternehmensintegrator über Tech Ops, Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering & Maintenance (E&M) und ermöglicht Kapitalprojekte, die sicherstellen, dass technische Absichten, Prozessreife, Validierungsergebnisse, Programmerwerbe und regulatorisch ausgerichtete technische Inhalte kohärent in effektive und nachhaltige Ausführung im Maßstab übersetzt werden. In this position, you will have the opportunity to shape how medicines are delivered to CSL’s patients, advance global sustainability objectives, and drive category transformation by developing long-term strategies. This includes overseeing the transition from conventional materials and processes to innovative, patient-focused, and environmentally sustainable solutions. In this role, you will influence and drive complex global category strategies across CSL’s product portfolio working with manufacturing, supply chain, technical operations (including primary packaging, device, and human factors areas within DDSP), quality, commercial, regulatory, and procurement. You will act as a thought leader in technology, sustainability, and supplier innovation, steering CSL packaging strategy toward future‑ready solutions. Responsibilities
• Evolve secondary packaging development processes – you will champion new processes, the adoption of new tools, data driven decision making, and advanced technologies across the packaging value chain. This will also include integration into combination product development processes.
• Develop secondary packaging designs and capabilities to ensure that CSL products meet market, regulatory compliance, quality, and manufacturing requirements. Assess secondary packaging failures to determine root causes and corrective actions.
• Deliver meaningful sustainability impact – you will shape initiatives that will ensure we meet global environmental commitments.
• Contribute to a high-performing global supplier network – partner with supply chain and procurement on: supplier partnerships to drive innovation pipelines and ensure resilience and quality of our global packaging supply base.
• Professional knowledge to coach and mentor direct reports and to provide career development for team members.
• Responsible for creating workforce plans, succession plans, and staffing plans for to ensure available talent is maximized to achieve business results for CSL. Qualifications

• At least 10 years of related experience in secondary packaging within the medical device and or pharmaceutical industry.
• Expertise in serialization and other anticounterfeit measures
• Experience with ISTA and ASTM for packaging and simulated shipping.
• Proven ability to develop strategies and lead improvement projects.
• Excellent communication skills and a track record working in a matrix environment; Influencing/building/promoting a culture of continuous improvement.
• Strong leadership through a partnership and engagement approach with manufacturing for advancing quality outcomes and operational excellence. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries. For our CSL Behring Operations / Manufacturing, we are looking for a Head of Manufacturing Engineering and Maintenance Closing Date for Applications – 17th April 2026 The Head of Manufacturing Engineering & Maintenance is a strategic leader responsible for the reliability and lifecycle management of manufacturing assets. This role oversees Calibration & Metrology Engineering, Manufacturing Maintenance, Reliability Engineering, Production/System Owner Engineering, and Shutdown Planning & Scheduling. Key responsibilities support critical operations, including fractionation, bulk production, and packaging, while ensuring equipment readiness and compliance with regulatory standards in the biopharmaceutical sector. The position also requires strong skills in labour relations to foster collaboration within a unionized workforce. Role that this position reports to: Engineering & Maintenance Site Head Job Purpose
• Direct all aspects of manufacturing engineering and maintenance, including technical support, project management, emergency response, on-call, troubleshooting and corrective, preventive/predictive maintenance
• Ensure facilities and equipment are designed, operated and maintained in compliance with cGMP, Health Authorities (i.e. FDA), EHS
• Drives execution of qualification plans, risk analysis, metrology, data integrity and general GMP issues
• Lead the planning, budgeting, execution and commissioning of major capital projects, facility expansions, and technology upgrades
• Champion asset lifecycle management, reliability engineering and implementation
• Oversees sites workshop operations
• Develop, communicate and execute an engineering and maintenance strategy
• Lead transformation initiatives, including digitalization, advanced automation, sustainability and adoption of cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
• Supports the development and implementation of multi-year strategic plans, capital investment roadmaps and operational readiness programs for all global site
• Lead the sites manufacturing engineering and maintenance organization
• Oversee deviation management, investigation of deviations and establishment of corrective and preventive actions plus develop, monitor and report on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for engineering and maintenance
• Represent the local manufacturing engineering and maintenance function in regulatory inspections, audit readiness
• Champion the use of digital tools and data analytics (e.g., SAP, Trackwise, FMS, Ariba, Power BI, Smart Sheet, Tableau) and implement CSL Operating System, Six Sigma, Lean
• Conducts regular GEMBAS
• Oversee the management of GMP/non-GMP facility systems
• Manage relationships with external service providers, contractors and vendors
• Partner with Manufacturing, Quality, EHS, Supply Chain, IT and other departments
• Engage with global and regional leadership
• Lead, mentor and develop a diverse, cross-functional team
• Oversees assigned cost centres, monitors performances and acts on trends
• Develops budgets for OpEx and headcounts Your Skills and Experience
• Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical) required, a master’s preferred
• Minimum of ten years’ experience in the pharmaceutical, food, or chemical process industry
• At least five years of technical management or leadership experience
• Significant expertise in GMP/non-GMP manufacturing assets related to pharmaceutical production
• Expertise in sterile manufacturing, bulk production and finishing and packaging operations of (bio) pharmaceuticals
• Experience managing union and non-union workforces
• Advanced skills in facility management systems (Trackwise, SAP, FMS, Ariba, DCMS) and digital tools (MS Project, Excel, Power BI, Smart Sheet, Tableau)

Descrizione Il programmatore statistico principale è responsabile di fornire leadership e supporto pratico nello sviluppo e nella manutenzione delle capacità di programmazione statistica CSL che è tenuto a soddisfare gli obblighi normativi. Piani e conduce gli sforzi di produzione e validazione per la produzione progettata, questo può includere la supervisione del lavoro da parte dei CRO. - Collabora con i team di studio per garantire la qualità e l'accuratezza – quindi la disponibilità di presentazione – dei dati clinici richiesti dalle autorità (ad esempio SDTM, ADaM, tabelle, figure, elenchi, Defini.xml). Job Description: The engineering Associate Director of Sustaining Engineering is a new role within CSL’s Drug Delivery Systems & Packaging (DDSP). This role will provide technical leadership to support marketed combination products. The individual will work with DDSP and peer departments, e.g., Quality Assurance, to implement changes and improvements to combination products to ensure safety and reliability. Changes may include process optimization, CDMO evaluation, tech transfers, supplier-related changes, and risk management updates. This role will also identify and leverage best practices supporting the needs of a diverse combination product portfolio as well as formalizing and standardizing approaches. This role serves as a key interface between DDSP, project teams, External Organizations, Commercial, and corporate initiatives for scoping and vetting design improvement projects. Responsibilities:

• Partner with manufacturing, CDMOs, and quality to drive design improvements, process optimizations, and supplier changes through the appropriate change control and regulatory pathways.
• The Associate Director represents the function in cross-functional program teams, design reviews, and regulatory interactions, providing expert input on device reliability to Health Authority submissions (e.g., NDA/BLA device sections).
• The Associate Director supports regulatory audits and inspections and maintains a deep understanding of the evolving combination product regulatory landscape.
• Monitor and provide input into product complaint process to identify opportunities for improvement.
• Provide key insights and lessons learned to educate new product development leads on best practices.
• Utilize technical project management skills, including resource planning, work planning, risk management, prioritization, conflict management, change management, issue resolution, and progress reporting.
• Responsible for identifying and implementing requirements for safety, quality, and reliability are effectively met for CSL commercialized combination products. Basic Qualifications
• Bachelor’s in engineering (mechanical or chemical preferred)
• Minimum 10 years of experience in either parenteral or device manufacturing in the pharmaceutical space
